title: The quiet a held frame pushes into the sound looks like the freeze mock draws it
goal: When a frame is held and everything waits, the sound under the still is drawn as a filled dark piece with a small silence badge. The freeze walkthrough draws that stretch of the sound lane as an empty slot with a dashed edge, so the sound visibly stops where the picture stops. Draw it the mock's way so a person reads it as no sound at a glance.
notes: Mock: docs/design/mocks/pages/video-freeze-wt.html line 59 (.gapmark: 1px dashed --line-strong, radius 6, height 34) and line 346 (#audGap under the still, shown on step 3, data line 387). App: Sources/Photonz/ClipPiecesBar.swift, a held piece on a sound (isSound && piece.isHeld) draws the audio kind fill plus kitBadge("silence"). Found while building a-held-frame-on-the-timeline-looks-like-the-free (2026-10-08), whose audit names this task for the difference.
